class.name: SteamTradeSession
class.brief_description: Steam's acknowledgment of a request to open a trade between verified participants.
class.description: [method SteamPublisherInventory.start_trade] returns this detached record after a recognized affirmative response. The participants complete the transfer in Steam. Refresh inventory to observe changes after the transfer.

method.name: get_partner_id
method.description: Returns the verified partner's SteamID64 as a decimal string.

method.name: get_player_id
method.description: Returns the verified first player's SteamID64 as a decimal string.

method.name: is_acknowledged
method.description: Returns whether Steam acknowledged the request to start a trade.

members.member: Read-only acknowledgment of the trade request.
Read-only decimal SteamID64 of the verified partner.
Read-only decimal SteamID64 of the verified first player.
